prompt:

Asset type: revised architectural interior reference for the 2D game "Лавка у моря", landscape 3:2, one clean detailed image without UI.
Image 1 is the EXACT EMPTY ARCHITECTURAL ROOM to furnish. Preserve its architecture, camera, framing, doorway, window, corner beam, ceiling, skirting, floor and sunlight exactly. Image 2 is ONLY a furniture MATERIAL/DESIGN reference: honey-oak shelves, turquoise bases and cream trim. Do NOT copy its furniture placement, angles, lengths or obstructed doorway.
PRIMARY TASK: Furnish image 1 with two wall-mounted grocery display cabinets forming a snug perpendicular L in the rear corner, and one cashier counter. Correct architectural alignment is more important than symmetry or filling the canvas.
CRITICAL ROOM GEOMETRY:
- The LEFT cabinet's entire BACK is flat against the LEFT window wall. Its long shelf rails, top cap and plinth MUST follow precisely the direction and perspective of that left wall's turquoise skirting and window sill. Same wall-plane vanishing direction. Its depth edges follow the RIGHT-wall direction. It has ZERO rotation away from its wall.
- The RIGHT cabinet's entire BACK is flat against the RIGHT plaster wall. Its long shelf rails, top cap and plinth MUST follow precisely that right wall's skirting/ceiling direction, NOT a generic mirrored 25-degree sprite angle. Its depth edges follow the LEFT-wall direction. It has ZERO rotation away from its wall.
- The two cabinets meet neatly in the back corner as fitted wall furniture. They are matching designs at the same real height and depth, but their visible lengths may differ according to available wall space. Do NOT force equal screen widths.
- The empty reference's left and right wall directions are different projected slopes; derive furniture perspective from THESE walls, not from a symmetric isometric furniture pack.
- Every furniture vertical is parallel to the room's vertical timber posts. Shelves share the architecture's vanishing directions. NO independent diagonal display islands pretending to be against a wall.
UNOBSTRUCTED ENTRY IS MANDATORY:
Shorten the LEFT run and begin it farther from the entrance, in the farther part under the window. Keep the ENTIRE left cabinet silhouette, including protruding side supports, feet, shelf fronts and wicker bay, to the RIGHT of the entrance's inner vertical jamb, with a visibly generous extra clearance. The leftmost furniture silhouette should start around x25% of the canvas or farther right; the door jamb is near x18%. Leave a clear broad floor corridor from the open threshold into the central room: minimum a comfortable person's width, approximately 90cm. No cabinet edge or counter enters this corridor; no furniture overlaps the door leaf, opening, threshold or door swing. It is fine to leave the closest section under the window unoccupied.
CABINET DESIGN:
Substantial raised two-tier wooden grocery displays with turquoise/cream end supports and lower wicker storage, same cozy polished game style as image2. Moderate SHALLOW depth suitable against walls, not oversized deep freestanding blocks. Four separate-looking milk/honey/jam/lemon items on each upper shelf; two shallow wicker trays holding a pear and a loaf on each middle shelf. VERY LOW front tray rims, just two wicker weave rows, unobstructed contents.
CASHIER COUNTER:
Honey-oak top, turquoise paneled base, cream corner columns, brass cash register. Place it in the foreground-right with a clear working aisle behind it and the entrance/central approach open on the left. Its long countertop front/back edges and plinth must be EXACTLY parallel in architectural perspective to the RIGHT wall and RIGHT cabinet long edges; its depth edges follow the LEFT wall. No casually angled counter, no 3-degree/10-degree/30-degree independent rotation. Same room axes, coherent shared perspective, all legs visibly grounded on the floor.
Keep warm sunlight, turquoise and cream Mediterranean room, fine wood grain, soft realistic contact shadows, recognizable polished casual-game art. Preserve window sea view. Leave clear bare wall above the right cabinet; no sign for this geometry reference. No interface, badges, arrows, measurement labels, diagram lines, lettering, extra furniture, people, watermark or borders. Do not move or narrow the doorway to fake clearance. Do not use camera or architecture changes to fake furniture alignment.
